oem.title: OEM / ODM Faucet Manufacturing
oem.lead: The right manufacturing partnership for your needs.
oem.oem_text: You provide the designs, specifications, samples or technical requirements; we coordinate production accordingly, faithfully reproducing what you asked for.
oem.odm_text: Based on your needs, we help coordinate everything from product development to production within existing capabilities. The exact scope depends on the product — we'll confirm the details with you in advance.
oem.todo_sub: Standing between you and the factory, we coordinate the entire flow so production runs smoothly.

todos.title: Requirement & Specification Confirmation
todos.text: We organize the product, structure, cartridge specifications, surface finishing, quantities, target pricing and lead times, and align them with the factory.

todos.title: Quotation Coordination
todos.text: We coordinate with the factory based on the confirmed details and provide you with a quotation.

todos.title: Sample Arrangement
todos.text: We arrange sampling and follow up so your revision requests are implemented quickly.

todos.title: Mass Production Follow-up
todos.text: We follow production scheduling, components, quality and lead times throughout.

todos.title: Quality & Lead-Time Communication
todos.text: We communicate quality confirmations and lead-time adjustments with the factory on your behalf.

todos.title: Shipment Coordination
todos.text: We help arrange shipment according to your order and destination.

oem.honest: We never exaggerate our design or R&D capabilities. We only commit to what we can actually deliver, and we state it clearly before we start.

about.title: About Us
paragraphs: HAICE Faucet supports overseas customers with faucet OEM / ODM manufacturing in China.
We work with faucet factories in China, coordinating product specifications, sampling, mass production, quality confirmation and lead-time management according to customer requirements.
Our partner factories have a production cooperation relationship with TOTO and maintain high standards of production management and quality requirements.
We provide Chinese, Japanese, English and Korean communication support to help overseas customers work smoothly with faucet manufacturing in China.
about.model_note: HAICE Faucet itself is not a factory, but a production support partner connecting you with partner factories in China. Actual manufacturing is done by the partner factories; we handle communication and end-to-end production coordination.
about.lang_text: We provide Chinese, Japanese, English and Korean communication support.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How HAICE Faucet handles personal information.

paras: Information you provide via the inquiry form or email — such as your name, company, email address, country/region and message — is used only to respond to your inquiry.
The information collected is used to respond to inquiries and to communicate with you about quotations, sampling, production and related matters.
We do not share your personal information with third parties without your consent, except where sharing with partner factories is necessary to arrange production.
This website may use access analytics to understand usage; no personally identifiable information is collected for this purpose.
If you have questions about how personal information is handled, please contact sales@haice.top.
